processor.notes: All twelve pins meet the housing. The core stays centered; the teal top edge sits on the core at both sizes.

memory.notes: Contacts share a baseline and meet the board. One contact carries teal; the slim board remains distinct at 32px.

wafer.notes: The nine-die grid fits inside the circular blank. Teal follows one existing die boundary; no grid edge escapes the wafer.

accelerator.notes: The bracket meets the card and the connector sits below it. Both fan rims are contained; teal follows one fan rim.

circuit-board.notes: Both terminals and the bent traces remain inside the board. The accented terminal rim stays attached at 32px.

chiplets.notes: The top rhombus closes cleanly. Two lower contours imply a parallel stack and never cross the front layer; one front edge is teal.

ai-model.notes: The brain contour and circuit traces read as one hybrid mark. Endpoint circles stay aligned; one existing trace is accented.

camera.notes: The lens is centered in the camera body. Its teal arc follows the lens rim without adding a floating feature.

server.notes: Two equal server units align vertically with a consistent gap. Only the upper status indicator is teal; both units remain distinct at 32px.

switch.notes: Three equal ports share a baseline and pitch. Each indicator sits above its port; the first indicator alone is teal.

storage.notes: The upper trapezoid terminates at the front panel seam. No rear edge crosses the panel; the drive indicator is a small accent.

cloud.notes: The contour stays continuous through the cloud lobes. Teal overlays a short lower edge; the silhouette remains clear in monochrome.

power.notes: The vertical actuator and interrupted circular ring stay separate by design. Teal marks the actuator tip rather than an invented light.

satellite.notes: The two panel contours meet the central body in the source view. Teal follows the antenna connection; the signal arc remains separate.

router.notes: The antenna meets the enclosure. Two source status lights stay aligned; only one is teal, with the radio arcs centered above.

network.notes: The source uplink meets the top node and the lower bus. All three nodes align on the shared routes; teal follows the uplink.

database.notes: The top ellipse and side edges join cleanly. Middle and lower rims share the cylinder width; teal follows the top rim.

dataset.notes: Rows and the central divider meet the table enclosure. Teal marks the header divider without changing the cell alignment.

document.notes: The folded corner meets the page outline. Text rows fit inside the page; one existing row carries the small accent.

folder.notes: The tab joins the folder contour cleanly. Teal follows the tab edge and stays visible without becoming an extra loose dash.

archive.notes: The box sides meet the lid. The centered handle is the only accented feature; the box remains clear at 32px.

terminal.notes: The prompt and cursor fit inside the terminal frame. Teal follows the cursor and monochrome removes the redundant overlay.

files.notes: A partial rear page sits behind the front page. Rear strokes remain outside the front silhouette; the front fold carries teal.

folders.notes: A partial rear folder sits behind the closed front folder. The tab carries teal; neither rear contour crosses the front face.

notebook.notes: Four binding strokes share their pitch and meet the cover edge. One binding is accented; the spine remains straight.

chart.notes: Three bars share a baseline with distinct heights. Teal stays on the tip of the tallest bar and does not imply an extra data series.

flask.notes: The neck and sloped sides form a closed flask. The liquid line terminates on both walls; only its central portion is teal.

microscope.notes: The objective, arm, stage and base retain their source relationships. Teal follows the stage; the objective stays above it.

calipers.notes: Revised the jaws to opposing faces with a clear gap. Both lower jaws are parallel; beam segments stop at the slider; the display fits inside.

compass.notes: The pivot anchors the two leg directions. The interrupted right leg and measurement arc retain the source geometry; teal follows the pivot.

target.notes: Three concentric circles share one center. The small inner rim carries teal; all rings remain distinct at 32px.

idea.notes: The bulb contour narrows toward the base. The two base strokes stay centered and separated; the upper base stroke has a restrained accent.

search.notes: Reduced the lens accent to a 45-degree arc after the first budget failure. The handle meets the lens at the source junction.

filter.notes: Three descending line lengths share their center. Only the middle of the shortest result line is teal; no added decorative dot.

settings.notes: The hub stays centered inside the gear contour. The small accent follows the hub rim and keeps the teeth in one ink colour.

branch.notes: The curved branch meets both circular endpoints in the source geometry. Teal follows the upper endpoint rim; the trunk remains continuous.

checklist.notes: Two checks align with their list rows. The lower check has one accented stroke segment; line spacing remains consistent at 32px.

shield-check.notes: The check sits inside the shield with clear margins. Teal follows a check segment; the outer contour stays continuous.

clock.notes: Both hands meet at the circle center. Teal lies on the minute hand; the outer rim and short hand remain legible in both palettes.

rocket.notes: The fins join the body at the source seams. The exhaust is intentionally separate; teal follows one existing fin edge.

message.notes: The tail joins the message outline. A short top-edge accent stays attached; no text or added internal detail competes at 32px.

mail.notes: The envelope fold meets the side edges within the frame. Teal follows one diagonal fold segment and remains distinct from the outer box.

slide-deck.notes: Three sheets use the same two-unit offsets. Rear top/right edges stay outside the front sheet; teal follows its title line.

person.notes: The head is centered over the shoulder contour. Teal follows a small head arc; the intentionally open lower profile remains clean.

calendar.notes: Two bindings align across the header. The divider meets both sides; one binding carries teal without adding a date glyph.

link.notes: Both curved link halves retain the source overlap and open ends. Teal follows one straight end segment; no false crossing was introduced.

globe.notes: The latitude line meets the outer rim and the meridian closes symmetrically. Teal follows a short equator segment through the center.

bookmark.notes: The crown and notched bottom close cleanly. Teal follows a short side edge, leaving the silhouette recognizable in every treatment.
